tasks.title: Split mission.md into composable rule files
tasks.description: Split sandbox/.claude/rules/mission.md (currently 76 lines after T1 trimming) into 3 files: (1) mission-core.md: role definition, decision framework, git safety, quality — universal to all agents. (2) mission-workflow.md: PR lifecycle, commit workflow, cross-contamination prevention, review responses — coder/refiner only. tasks.title: Add role-based rules_order in setup_agent_rules()
tasks.description: Modify setup_agent_rules() in sandbox/entrypoint.py (line 678) to ADD new logic that reads EGG_AGENT_ROLE and selects appropriate rule files per role. Currently setup_agent_rules() has NO role-based or pipeline-conditional logic — it includes ALL files from rules_order if they exist on disk. This task ADDS conditional logic. Define a ROLE_RULES mapping dict covering ALL AgentRole enum values from BOTH enums. When no role is set (interactive use), use the full file set for backward compatibility. ADD new pipeline-conditional logic: check EGG_PIPELINE_ID — contract.md and orchestrator.md should only be included when EGG_PIPELINE_ID is set AND the role uses them.

phases.name: Prompt Generation Unification
phases.goal: Move GHA prompt generation into a shared Python module so both GHA and orchestrator use the same prompt generators. Bash scripts become thin wrappers.

tasks.title: Create shared prompt builder Python module
tasks.description: Create shared/egg_prompts/ Python package. (1) criteria.py — unified criteria loading with 2-tier fallback (.egg/<name>-rules.md override → inline default). The inline defaults consolidate both the GHA inline heredocs and the orchestrator hardcoded string functions (_get_code_review_criteria at line 828, _get_contract_review_criteria at line 853, _get_agent_design_criteria at line 811, _get_unified_criteria at line 730, _get_refine_review_criteria at line 877, _get_plan_review_criteria at line 907). (2) conventions.py — conventions file loading from action/ directory with inline fallback. (3) builders.py — prompt builder functions for each GHA prompt type (review, autofixer, agent-design-review, contract-verification, conflict, doc-updater, feedback). (4) cli.py — CLI entrypoint for GHA invocation. The module must work in both Docker containers and GHA runners with Python 3.12+. No Docker-specific or orchestrator-specific dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Module is importable as `from egg_prompts import builders`
Criteria loading uses 2-tier fallback: .egg/<name>-rules.md → inline default

Inline defaults consolidate BOTH the GHA heredocs AND the orchestrator hardcoded functions (_get_code_review_criteria, _get_contract_review_criteria, _get_agent_design_criteria, _get_unified_criteria, _get_refine_review_criteria, _get_plan_review_criteria) — single source of truth
Conventions loading finds files relative to action/ directory, with inline fallback
Each builder function accepts context dict and returns prompt string
CLI entrypoint supports all 7 prompt types with appropriate arguments
CLI outputs prompt-file path and model to stdout for GITHUB_OUTPUT integration
No dependencies on orchestrator or Docker-specific packages
Unit tests exist for criteria loading, conventions loading, and each builder function
All tests pass

tasks.title: Migrate 4 GHA scripts with 2-tier fallback to Python

Each becomes a thin wrapper that validates env vars, calls python3 -m egg_prompts <subcommand>, captures prompt-file and model, writes to GITHUB_OUTPUT. Python builders must produce equivalent prompts. Create snapshot tests.
